---
title: "Downloads"
---

The workbook below holds the wood provision accounts of the EU27 for 2000, 2006, 2012, 2018 and 2024, in Excel format. It arranges the
actual flow, the sustainable flow and the overuse by NUTS0, NUTS2 and NUTS3, with one column per year, in physical terms and in
monetary terms. Physical values are in thousand cubic metres over bark, and monetary values are in million euro at current prices and at
constant 2010 prices. A further sheet gives the origin of each national value.

The 100 m maps are too large for the repository, so they are kept in an external folder. It holds 30 GeoTIFF files, with six maps per year of
the actual flow, the sustainable flow and the overuse, in physical terms and at constant 2010 prices. A `README.md` file in that folder explains
the units and how to read them.

Values for 2024 mostly repeat the last year reported for each Member State, because Eurostat holds few values for that year. The
[report](../documentation/methods/wood-provision/index.qmd) explains how each file was produced and how to read it.
